notes: errors: std::error::Error is the error interface; Unwrap is Error::source and As is downcast_ref. rust_stdlib::error adds what std lacks: Joined (Join), Message (New, ErrUnsupported; compared by identity), and is/find, which walk source chains and Joined trees depth first.

As.note: targets are concrete error types; a type with Go's As method implements ErrorAs and calls error::register_as::<T>() once

Is.note: Equality is identity of Message values or the same object; Go's optional Is(error) bool method is ErrorIs, registered once with error::register_is::<T>() (Rust cannot discover a trait on a dyn Error)

Join.note: nil errors are filtered by the caller

New.note: Box<dyn Error>::from(str) also works; Message adds identity comparison
